pages.name: Herald of Hunger
pages.text: Comes after the Herald of Storm. Brings a rain of blood.

pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Within its territory a $(thing)rain of blood$() falls. Every successful hit lowers your hunger bars and applies Hunger. Without food this can end in death by the usual rules.

pages.title: How to defeat it
pages.text: $(li)$(#2E7D4F)Scythe of the Beyond$() restores hunger by its usual mechanic, and its charge halts mobs: use that window to attack.$(li)$(#2E7D4F)Fern Pearl$(): fully restores health and hunger.$(li)Bring plenty of food.

pages.title: Reward
pages.text: Victory leaves a $(item)Heart of Hunger$(), embodying the Path of Hunger.
